admission.justification: This clause names the order of the existing tick's usage read and its delivery pass, whose reversal would deliver against a stale limit or delay a cleared seat to the sweep.

applicability: Every held-delivery tick that runs a usage batch before its delivery pass.
conditions: The batch runs before deliver_ended_turns and before the sweep in the same tick.
A limit the batch cleared lets the existing drain deliver the eligible held messages in their recorded order.
exclusions: A recipient still in a turn, archived, or owing a permission is not delivered by this clause.
A delivery that needs a later receipt-cursor tick.
statement: A due read that clears a limit lets the eligible held messages drain in order without a turn end.
